goal: Allow logging macros to accept context arguments for custom metadata and target logger instances
Enables libbitcoinkernel users to capture isolated logs without relying on shared global state
Lets subsystems attach custom metadata while still using standard log level macros
reviewability: Author has been silent for 121 days and responses may take time
agreement: Concept objection: multiple loggers add unnecessary complexity and separate processes suffice (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: commits are too large to comprehend and have abstraction issues (l0rinc)
Concept approval: instanced logging aids kernel use cases like parallel chainstate managers (sedited)
Concept approval: separating logging facility from severity improves the macro design (vasild, jonatack)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it decouples logging from a global instance to enable isolated log capture
Provides leverage for libbitcoinkernel decoupling and unblocks #30342
